cards.example: Ayon sa mga taga-usig, may pagtatakip sa mga ari-arian na hindi nakalagay sa mga deklarasyon.
cards.exampleMeaning: According to the prosecutors, there is a concealing of assets that are not in the declarations.
cards.note: Mula sa ugat na 'takip'. May kasamang intensyon, kaya mabigat ang paratang. Pormal na rehistro; sa karaniwang usapan, 'tinatakpan' o 'ikinukubli'.

cards.meaning: apprehension; worry about what may come
cards.example: Lumalaki ang pangamba ng mga mamimili na hindi na aabot ang kanilang sahod sa susunod na buwan.
cards.exampleMeaning: Consumers' worry is growing that their pay will not stretch to next month.
cards.note: Mas mabagal at mas pinag-iisipan kaysa 'takot'; karaniwan sa headline ng ekonomiya. Kamag-anak ng 'agam-agam', na mas panloob.

cards.example: 今年前八个月，中国的贸易顺差已经超过8000亿美元。
cards.examplePinyin: Jīnnián qián bā gè yuè, Zhōngguó de màoyì shùnchā yǐjīng chāoguò bāqiān yì měiyuán.
cards.exampleMeaning: In the first 8 months of this year, China's trade surplus has already exceeded $800 billion.
cards.note: 书面语/finance register. Collocates with 贸易, 保持, 出现; opposite 逆差. Contrast 盈余: a broader surplus (budget, account); 顺差 is specifically the in/out balance.

cards.meaning: to take the place of; to replace and become the replacement
cards.example: 房地产不再是增长的引擎，取而代之的是出口。
cards.examplePinyin: Fángdìchǎn bú zài shì zēngzhǎng de yǐnqíng, qǔ ér dài zhī de shì chūkǒu.
cards.exampleMeaning: Real estate is no longer the engine of growth; what has taken its place is exports.
cards.note: 书面语. Abstract connective-like idiom, usually 取而代之的是…. Contrast 代替: neutral, also for ordinary substitution; 取而代之 describes a change in who holds the position.
cards.tiesTo: AI-linked exports replacing property as growth driver
